name: avenue_markings
author: netmod (task avenues)
description: The stock straight avenue (11204) and its end caps (11203) with white dashed lane lines instead of the yellow centre line (owner, 2026-10-17: on avenues every lane gets a white dashed line). Pattern from stock highway 73: four dashes per cell. Built by `py -3 ../../avenue_markings.py build .` in this folder before install (art/ is made from the game's frames and is not shipped). Layer 1 of 11204 (the median trees) stays stock.
